Newsletter
March 2025

Dear members,
 
The second module has concluded and we have now gotten start with the third, over the holidays we had a lot of fun together celebrating traditions such as sinterklaas, and having some really good bites together at the RPG 💗. We're looking forward to spending the rest of another great new year with all of you! A few days ago we had our half-year GMM during which we reflected on the past half year of being a board and we were happy to see a great attendance this year. I will now catch you up on what has been happening this year and what will be happening in the upcoming weeks.


Happy New Years from Board VIII Wasted 💗

 

Sincerely, 
Joris Jonkers

Secretary & External Affairs of E.S.A. Blueshell
­

December in Blueshell

This month was in the theme of the holidays and its communal spirit, we therefore hosted many cross over events with other associations. For instance, we had an opportunity to bond with some of our fellow sports associations such as the dancing associations; Chassé, Primo Ballerino, 4HappyFeet, Break Even, and Arabesque. Further we also shared a lovely NintenCo Mario Kart Tournament with A La Kart and the MotorSportGroep. Then, to top all of the great shared events off we had a huge shared gambling gamenight withe Dimensie and Proto!

­

Events

In december we hosted several Sinterklaas events and also hosted our biggest collaborative event yet, the Blueshell x Proto x Dimensie Gambling Night! A huge number of people joined this event and they all became aware of our existence as an association. We also had a great time competing against the other associations at the Open Mario Kart Tournament, where we showed them who's boss by winning it! 
­

Sinterklaas Gift Exchange

We started of the month, and the celebrations, with the Sinterklass Gift Exchange, we had a ton of people from the association show up and share their gifts some of which were particularly desirable. Unfortunately, we didn't have the most equal spread of gifts at the end of the night, but as we have so many nice members in our association those who had much shared with the rest, and everybody got to go home with some lovely gifts of their own, thanks a lot for sharing your love everyone 💗
­

Blueshell x Proto x Dimensie Gambling Night

Halfway through the month we hosted a huge shared event with the student asssociations Proto and Dimensie. During this combined gambling night the lounge was filled with students who got to share in all that Blueshell has to offer. The horse betting was particularly popular and we have been told that everyone present enjoyed themselves tremendously! If you have any notes or feedback on how we can make these events even more enjoyable for our members, feel free to reach out to the board :)
­

NintenCo Open Mario Kart Tournament

We had a great cross over event with A La Kart and the MotorSportGroep of the university to see which association rules supreme over racing here at the university. Unforunately A La Kart decided to FF at 0 bc none of them showed up, however, the MSG put up a strong fight and almost ended up in the finals, but as it turns out the association named after a Mario Kart item is in fact better in Mario Kart, as NintenCo's own Sanne won the tournanement!
­

RPG Really Good Potluck

As the holidays arrived we closed of the month with one final event the RPG, Really Good Potluck! A great event in which a ton of our members showed up to share their Christmas cheer with the association. A ton of us were able to make it, and I heard that the apple cinnamon bread baked by Thijs was  particularly delicious, thanks so much for sharing it with us 💗
­

Esports Update

This month in Esports the DSL Fall Split concluded, and we are pleased to announce that we have won the tournament series for the second time in a row! We want to give a special thanks to all our members who played for us and kept an eye on the Esports announcements channel 💗 As the spring split is now starting up again, please once more keep an eye on the DSL discord and the Esports Announcements chat to help us win for the third time!
­

January in Blueshell 

In the month of January we all had our exams unfortunately ;-;
For this reason the board decided to push most events into February instead such that we can all get back to studying and hanging out as soon as the module is over :)

Nevertheless, we do have some great events coming up for you in these trying (exam) times! 💗
­

Events

We hosted only a few events this month due to the exam periods of the second module, however, we did still have some good times together.
­

4FunCie Ice Skating

We all went ice skating together some of which were doing it for the first time and I heard they all did great. We had lots of fun playing with the penguins and messing around in the hockey  ring. Completely unexpectedly the event aligned with a disco event that was going on at the same time which was great luck!
­

Murder Mystery Night!

The murder mystery night was great fun and we saw many members that don't normally participate in events show their faces! The puzzles were challenging and many but our smart membership managed to solve them and have a great time too. Due to the success of the event we'll be taking all the feedback we got into account and will organize a new one next year. 
­

Esports

As we were in between splits of the DSL we unfortunately don't have an Esports update for this month.
­

February in Blueshell

With the end of the exams and beginning of the new module this month has had a flurry of activity in the association, with a grand total of 9 events! We not only had a great number of events but we also had some of our best attended events yet, with major collaborations with Fanaat for the Kick-In and with the Erasumus Student Network too. Further, the upcoming spring split of the DSL has meant that our Esports affairs got started on forming new teams and signing everyone up.  
­

Events

In February we hosted a grand total of 9 events, this was due to the board making sure that we all got enough to do as our module started! I'll now briefly go over some of the most fun events that we've hosted \:)
­

4FunCie Glow Golfing

Our Glowgolfing event was a blast! With glowing courses and tricky obstacles, everyone brought their best game and had an awesome time. It was great to see so many people join in, and we're looking forward to planning more fun outings like this!
­

DisCo Karaoke

At the DisCo Karaoke night we had a blast singing with everyone, we made sure that we got some good speakers and microphones for the event and it was a huge improvement. We found out that there was a constitution drink for the student union at the same time from which we got a fair few participants who we loved singing with!
­

Upcoming in March

With the third module now well on the way we are still actively hosting a ton of events for you this month, on top of that the DSL Spring Split has officially begun and our teams will soon be competing again, wish them luck! The month also started off with the half-year GMM for which we got a great number of attendants! I'll now give you a quick recap on what has already happened over the past week and what all will be coming up this month.
­

Half-Year GMM

On the third of March the 8th board hosted their Half-Year GMM and we were happy to see a great number of attendants at this special occasion. The GMM was mostly spent reflecting on the past half-year and how we as a board have managed the association in this time. Key takeaways were that the board needs to refocus on running the visible parts of the association over managing the behind the scenes, and that the board will work on its event attedance and communication to our members. Unfortunately due to how long the half-year GMM took the board was unable to get approval for all documents and a second GMM will be scheduled in April to approve the Long-Term Vision 2025-2030 proposal of the ViCie committee of the association. More information on this will follow soon!
­

Events

Over the coming month we have a fair few events coming up, it would be great to see you all at the Valorant Spike Night to help all of our teams warm up for competition!
­

Esports Update 

This month the spring split of the DSL is starting the board is hoping to see the same level of enthusiasm as shown in the past split once more this spring. Though we understand that there were some changes to handing out college coins/tournament series points, the board hopes this won't discourage people from joining the tournaments. In fact, to tackle this, the board will try to improve this for upcoming split via:

  1. In our meeting with DSL, we discussed whether the minimum requirement could be lowered for tournaments that need teams (e.g., 5v5 tournaments were extremely hard to fulfill the quota). The board hopes that this will encourage more teams to join in DSL tournaments.
  2. New @unknown-user role. This role is obtainable in (⁠Blueshell Esports⁠), and the board will start pinging this role for any DSL tournaments or external tournaments! In fact, the board wonders whether this is enough or if it might be better for the community to also be able to ping this. If you consider picking this role up, please react to the poll down below.
  3. Better promotion for the DSL tournaments. Aside from occasionally pinging people, the board will attempt to ping the tournaments role regularly with 'decent' promotion.

Anyways, to kick off, the schedule for March is shown below. Thank you all for taking the time to read this message, and let's get the W again for the upcoming split! 

Kind regards,
Chris Wong

Treasurer and Commissioner of Esports Affairs of ESA Blueshell
 
­

DSL Spring Split

This months calendar for the DSL Spring Split has gone online, the preliminary list of events is given here, we hope to see you all participate in as many events as possible!
